summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser in rdflib/extras/shacl.py (parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError) and added tests in test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and the existing test/test_path.py pass (42 passed). Nothing is committed and no other files changed. Not verified: mypy, ruff and black are not installed in the shared venv and I was not allowed to install them, so the type-check gate and black formatting were checked only by reading the code and a line-length check.
